=================================================================
 Hexchess Magic Bitboard Tables
 Board:   11x11 rhombus, u128, idx=r*11+c
          A1=idx0 (bottom), K11=idx120 (top)
          bits 121-127 unused (7 wasted MSBs)
 Valid:   |r-c|<=5  ->  91 cells on-board, 30 off-board
 Axes:    r-axis (+/-1,0), c-axis (0,+/-1), diag (+/-1,+/-1)
 Rook:    3 separate axis magics (max ~9 bits each)
          rookAttacks = ROOK_R | ROOK_C | ROOK_X
 Bishop:  single magic (max 8 bits)
 Queen:   rookAttacks(sq,occ) | bishopAttacks(sq,occ)
 Magic:   index = (occupied & mask) * magic >> shift
          shift = 128 - popcount(mask)
=================================================================

OFF_BOARD_MASK = 0x0007C0780700600400400C01C03C07C0u;  // 30 off-board cells

=================================================================
 ROOK MAGICS  (3 axes, each max ~9 blocker bits)
=================================================================

struct ROOK_RMagic {
    u128 mask;   // blocker mask (inner squares, perimeter excluded)
    u128 magic;  // magic multiplier
    int  shift;  // 128 - popcount(mask)
};
